## Task 5: PCA for dimensionality reduction

Use a 10,000-row sample so this task runs quickly.

```{r task5-setup}
set.seed(602)
health_small <- simulate_bdat602(n = 10000, seed = 602)

pca_vars <- c("age", "bmi", "income", "premium", "deductible",
              "num_chronic_conditions", "num_visits",
              "num_prescriptions", "num_hospital_admissions",
              "num_claims", "avg_past_claim", "claim_amount",
              "app_logins_monthly", "support_calls", "policy_age_months")
```

```{r task5-recipe}
library(broom)

# TODO: build a recipe that normalises then applies step_pca with num_comp = 5
pca_rec <- recipe(~ ., data = health_small[, pca_vars]) |>
  NULL  # step_normalize(...) then step_pca(...)

# TODO: prep and bake
pca_prep   <- NULL  # prep(pca_rec)
pca_scores <- NULL  # bake(pca_prep, new_data = NULL)

# Peek at the first few score rows
head(pca_scores)
```
